scope: Tracked working files (including staged documentation) and every local Git blob/commit object, including any unreachable objects. Report itself is produced after inspection.

retained_metadata.note: Standard Git author/committer names/emails and working-directory paths in original evidence remain. Actual identities and keys are not copied into this report; history and raw evidence were not rewritten.

evidence_audit.limitation: Pattern scan is a submission check, not proof against every secret format.

verification_performed_this_turn: Content/history scans, local link checks, recorded evidence hash and state re-evaluation only; no pytest rerun and no model API calls.
limitations: Exact configured key and listed credential/contact/home-directory formats were checked. Pattern scans cannot exclude every unknown secret or personal-data format. Git authorship metadata still needs the owner's publication-scope review.
